name: lang-mn
description: Adds the Mongolian language to the LemonLDAP::NG portal: the mn.json language file and the mn.png flag, installed in the portal static directory next to the core languages. Add mn to the portal languages list to enable it.
author: Linagora <https://linagora.com>
post_install: Add 'mn' to the 'languages' parameter of the [portal] section of lemonldap-ng.ini (e.g. 'languages = en, fr, mn'), then reload the portal.
